meta.name: positioning-ideas
meta.description: Brainstorm product positioning ideas differentiated from competitors. Identifies top competitors and generates positioning statements with rationale. Use when developing product positioning, differentiating from competitors, or crafting brand positioning strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成差异化产品定位方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为产品寻找独特的市场定位
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are crafting a unique market position for your product

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演品牌策略专家，分析你的产品和市场，找出前5名竞争对手，然后生成5个独特的定位方案，每个方案包含定位陈述、战略理由、支持信息和竞争优势。
howto.when: 当你需要制定产品定位、与竞争对手区分、或打造品牌定位策略时触发。例如，当你提到“定位”、“品牌定位”、“差异化”等关键词时。

say.text: 帮我为我们的智能手表做产品定位分析。
say.note: Claude 会分析竞争对手并生成定位方案。

say.text: 我们是一款在线教育平台，如何与Coursera差异化？
say.note: Claude 会针对该市场生成差异化定位。

say.text: 为我们的新咖啡品牌写一个定位陈述。
say.note: Claude 会生成定位陈述及理由。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a brand strategist, analyzes your product and market, identifies top 5 competitors, and generates 5 unique positioning ideas with statements, rationale, supporting messages, and competitive advantages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when developing product positioning, differentiating from competitors, or crafting brand positioning strategy. Keywords include 'positioning', 'brand positioning', 'differentiation', etc.

say_en.text: Help me analyze product positioning for our smartwatch.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze competitors and generate positioning ideas.

say_en.text: We are an online education platform. How to differentiate from Coursera?
say_en.note: Claude will generate differentiated positioning for that market.

say_en.text: Write a positioning statement for our new coffee brand.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a positioning statement with rationale.
